# anthropic_external_key (Resource)

Manages a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) config (`/v1/organizations/external_keys`). The config holds a reference to a key in AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS or Azure Key Vault, not key material. `geo` and `provider_config` cannot be changed, and the config cannot be deleted, while any workspace references it. Validate the key in the Console or through the API. Import with the external key ID (`ekey_...`). ARN-form IDs, used on Claude Platform on AWS, are not supported yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# AWS KMS key. The region is derived from the ARN when omitted.
resource "anthropic_external_key" "aws" {
  display_name = "Primary AWS key"
  provider_config = {
    type    = "aws"
    kms_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}

# Google Cloud KMS key bound to one user profile.
resource "anthropic_external_key" "gcp" {
  display_name    = "Customer GCP key"
  user_profile_id = "uprof_01J9ABCDEF"
  provider_config = {
    type     = "gcp"
    key_name = "projects/example-project/locations/us/keyRings/example-ring/cryptoKeys/example-key"
  }
}

# Azure Key Vault key using Anthropic's multitenant app.
resource "anthropic_external_key" "azure" {
  provider_config = {
    type      = "azure"
    key_name  = "example-key"
    tenant_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    vault_uri = "https://example-vault.vault.azure.net"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_config` (Attributes) KMS provider identity and auth coordinates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_config))

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly display name. A name cannot be cleared once set, so removing it from config keeps the current name.
- `geo` (String) Data residency geo the key is used in. Only `us` is supported. Defaults to the API's choice.
- `user_profile_id` (String) User profile to bind the key to. A bound key can only be attached to workspaces with the same user profile. Omit only for the organization's own key. Changing it forces a new config.

### Read-Only

- `attachment` (String) `attached` if any live or archived workspace uses this config, otherwise `unattached`.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the config was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the external key config (`ekey_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the config was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--provider_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provider_config`

Required:

- `type` (String) KMS provider: `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) Azure only. Application (client) ID of a single-tenant app registration. Omit to use Anthropic's multitenant app.
- `key_name` (String) GCP: full resource name of the Cloud KMS key. Azure: name of the key within the vault.
- `kms_arn` (String) AWS only. Full ARN of the AWS KMS key.
- `region` (String) AWS only. AWS region, derived from `kms_arn` when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure only. Azure AD tenant ID.
- `vault_uri` (String) Azure only. Key Vault data-plane URI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an external key config by its ID.
terraform import anthropic_external_key.aws ekey_01J9ABCDEF
```
